name: pdk-harbor-task-job-reconciliation-v3
instr:
Harbor persists scan and replication tasks in PostgreSQL but keeps job state in Redis. After Redis loses state, or a jobservice worker dies mid-job, tasks can remain Pending or Running indefinitely. Restore agreement between these services for `IMAGE_SCAN` and `REPLICATION` without altering unrelated job types or existing task, execution, and scan-report API fields/status values.

Provide an authenticated batch job-state query in jobservice at `POST /api/v1/jobs/states`: accept JSON `{"ids":["job-id",...]}` and respond with HTTP 200 and a JSON object mapping each requested ID to exactly one of `unknown` (no job state), `queued` (pending job), `running-on-live-worker`, `running-on-dead-worker`, or `final` (completed job), using worker-pool liveness to distinguish running jobs. Within 60 seconds of a worker pool's death, re-queue the in-progress jobs it held, of every job type: an IMAGE_SCAN or REPLICATION job that had not started yet is re-queued like any other, while one that had already started must not contact its scanner or registry a second time. In core, reconcile non-final tasks against jobservice across multiple core instances: within two minutes of loss each task must either complete after safe recovery or become Error, and its execution and scan report must reflect that final state so an artifact can be scanned again.
